01 — Flagship case study

QueEase — designing a calmer way to wait.

QueEase was developed as a collaborative final-year thesis project. My main hands-on contribution was the application: I designed and implemented the overall app experience, including the UI/screens and admin portal, and handled the Firebase work with some supervisor guidance. The thesis/research documentation was completed collaboratively by the three group members.

Problem

Physical queues create uncertainty, crowding, wasted time, and limited visibility.

Solution

Digital tokens, queue tracking, notifications, and flexible waiting actions.

Design workflow

Prompt → generate → review → edit → adapt → implement.

Validation

16 documented functional test cases were recorded as passed.

QueEase system

One system, three experiences.

The product connects the customer journey with staff operations and administrative visibility.

Customer

Book & Track

Select a branch/service, book a token, monitor progress, receive updates, and manage the visit.

Staff

Serve & Manage

Work with active tokens and keep the queue moving through operational actions.

Admin

Monitor & Control

Manage branches/services, monitor queue operations, notifications, and analytics.

Customer flow

From intent to service.

The visible flow stays simple while the underlying product handles multiple roles, branches, services, queues, tokens and records.

01

Select

Choose a branch and required service.

02

Book

Confirm the visit and receive a digital token.

03

Track

Follow queue position and waiting information.

04

Adjust

Delay or cancel when circumstances change.
